title: Decision of the EEA Joint Committee No 98/2026 of 20 March 2026 amending Annex XI (Electronic communication, audiovisual services and information society) to the EEA Agreement [2026/1238]
text:
Official Journal of the European Union
EN
L series
2026/1238
25.6.2026
DECISION OF THE EEA JOINT COMMITTEE No 98/2026
of 20 March 2026
amending Annex XI (Electronic communication, audiovisual services and information society) to the EEA Agreement [2026/1238]
THE EEA JOINT COMMITTEE,
Having regard to the Agreement on the European Economic Area (“the EEA Agreement”), and in particular Article 98 thereof,
Whereas:
(1)
Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2025/2425 of 2 December 2025 on the harmonisation of the 3800-4200 MHz frequency band for the shared use by terrestrial wireless broadband systems capable of providing local-area network connectivity in the Union  ( 1 ) is to be incorporated into the EEA Agreement.
(2)
Annex XI to the EEA Agreement should therefore be amended accordingly,
HAS ADOPTED THIS DECISION:
Article 1
The following point is inserted after point 5czv (Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2024/1983) of Annex XI to the EEA Agreement:
‘5czw.
32025 D 2425 : Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2025/2425 of 2 December 2025 on the harmonisation of the 3800-4200 MHz frequency band for the shared use by terrestrial wireless broadband systems capable of providing local-area network connectivity in the Union ( OJ L, 2025/2425, 4.12.2025 ).’
Article 2
The text of Implementing Decision (EU) 2025/2425 in the Icelandic and Norwegian languages, to be published in the EEA Supplement to the Official Journal of the European Union , shall be authentic.
Article 3
This Decision shall enter into force on 21 March 2026, provided that all the notifications under Article 103(1) of the EEA Agreement have been made  ( *1 ) .
Article 4
This Decision shall be published in the EEA Section of, and in the EEA Supplement to, the Official Journal of the European Union .
Done at Brussels, 20 March 2026.
For the EEA Joint Committee
The President
Nicolas VON LINGEN
( 1 )
OJ L, 2025/2425, 4.12.2025, ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/dec_impl/2025/2425/oj .
( *1 )   No constitutional requirements indicated.
